features.quote: Define a hard iteration cap (e.g. 15 iterations or N tokens) regardless of behavior.
features.justification_quote: Don't run 'until it gives up' — that makes duration a dependent variable confounded with your outcome.

features.quote: Define a stop-on-distress rule... Pick a pre-registered threshold (e.g. explicit statements of distress, repeated requests to stop) that halts that run.
